description: Platform-specific helpers for Facebook, X, LinkedIn, Instagram, Reddit and Strava.

tools.name: Lookup-ID
tools.desc: Facebook profile/page/group URL to its numeric ID

tools.name: Who Posted What?
tools.desc: Facebook keyword search by date range and profile ID

tools.name: Facebook search URL notes
tools.desc: How to build Facebook search URLs with filters (posts, people, dates)

tools.name: FDown
tools.desc: Download a public Facebook video by URL

tools.name: X advanced search
tools.desc: Native X search: from:, to:, since:, until:, geocode:, filter:media

tools.name: Botometer X
tools.desc: Bot-likelihood score of an X account (historical data only)

tools.name: LinkedIn X-ray via Google
tools.desc: Google dork builder for LinkedIn profiles by title, company, location

tools.name: Imginn
tools.desc: Anonymous Instagram viewer: posts, stories, tagged, without login

tools.name: Inflact avatar downloader
tools.desc: Full-size Instagram profile picture of a username

tools.name: Reddit User Analyser
tools.desc: Reddit account activity: subreddits, active hours, top words

tools.name: Strava Global Heatmap
tools.desc: Aggregated running/cycling routes; reveals bases, homes, routines
